$description: Shingō 信号 design tokens. Source of truth for web/shingo.css and ios/Sources/ShingoKit/SGTheme.swift.

color.$note: Two modes, same layering. Dark = ink stripe ground + sage slabs (the poster). Light = sage stripe ground + paper slabs (never white). Ink and coral barely move.

roles.ground-3: rules, rings and raised controls on the ground
roles.ground-hi: titles and line art on the ground
roles.sage-lo: pressed, dividers on slabs, toggle track
roles.ink: text on slabs and solid objects (buttons, slots, solid X, tab bar)
roles.ground-dim: sublines and meta on the ground

japanese.use: vertical captions, hanko seals, outlined kanji

french.use: italic asides, dates, taglines, pull quotes

typeScale.$note: Wordmark type uses only display / title / inline. Nothing in between.

cut.$note: every utility slab edge; the 45° band is poster-tier only

rules: Two tiers: poster screens compose freely; every other screen follows the screen grammar.
Ground on top, slab below, split along a diagonal. In both modes the slab is the lighter layer, and stripes stay on the ground.
Rounded forms are stadiums, circles and the rounded X only. Rectangles stay square or chamfered, never a generic corner radius.
Mono telemetry is right-aligned to the gutter. Wordmarks are uppercase Archivo Expanded Black.
Decorative numbers and codes (09, #hex, sp c53) should be real values from the app wherever possible.
Language: English runs the interface. Japanese adds texture, at most one moment per screen. French is the italic aside, at most one per screen. All three stacked only once per app.
Every screen ships in both modes. Use role tokens (ground-hi, sage-hi), never raw hex. Anything that sits on the ground takes ground-* tokens; anything on a slab takes sage-* and ink.

tiers.utility: header → hero → cut → slab, for most screens
tiers.poster: launch, onboarding, lock screen, empty state: free composition

screenGrammar.header: title (28) + mono subline + exactly one tag: vertical Japanese, a hanko, short meta or one action
screenGrammar.hero: at most one form on the ground: a pill, a number, a card, a disc or a scope
screenGrammar.slab: content on a 24 pt gutter, ink on sage; group labels are mono with a hairline
screenGrammar.coral: the cut, plus at most one action and small state markers (unread, active tab, latest entry)
screenGrammar.languages: Japanese in the header tag or a seal; French in the subline (or fine print). One of each at most.
